_comment: Arcade profiles. Edit here on the owner's computer, then make deploy; nothing at the cabinet can change them. A combo is pressed one input at a time on the sign-in screen. Inputs: up, down, left, right, 1-6 (action buttons), start. Coin is never part of a combo: it clears the entry, and Coin + anything is a RetroArch hotkey. No combo may be the start of another.
